note: Submodule of registration. Adds one dynamic permission per workflow transition (use <workflow> <transition> transition), a transition route/form, and Cancel/transition UI operations. Config object registration_workflow.settings has require_update_access (default true) and prevent_complete_own (default false). Cases are grounded in that config object and the permission naming.

evals.prompt: What does the Registration Workflow submodule add on top of the base registration workflow states, and how does it let a role be allowed to cancel registrations?
evals.expected_output: It adds a permission per workflow transition and UI operations/buttons for transitions. To allow cancelling, grant the 'use registration cancel transition' permission (plus, by default, update access to the registration).

evals.prompt: In the Registration Workflow submodule, what is the naming pattern for the permission that governs a specific workflow transition? Give the permission that controls completing a registration in the default 'registration' workflow.
evals.expected_output: Pattern: `use <workflow_id> <transition_id> transition`. Completing uses `use registration complete transition`.

evals.prompt: Which two settings does the Registration Workflow submodule expose in registration_workflow.settings, and what do they do?
evals.expected_output: require_update_access (default true) requires the user to also have update access to the registration to transition it; prevent_complete_own (default false) stops users completing their own registrations.

evals.prompt: On this site, inspect the Registration Workflow configuration and state whether users are currently allowed to complete their own registrations.
evals.expected_output: No - users cannot complete their own registrations: registration_workflow.settings.prevent_complete_own is currently true.

evals.prompt: On this site, configure Registration Workflow so that users are not allowed to complete (approve) their own registrations, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: registration_workflow.settings.prevent_complete_own = true (set via config factory and save).
